findings.evidence: Diff: `change _ :: (p.supportAttach h.right_mem).unattach = _ :: p.support` and `change _ :: p.edgesAttach.unattach = _ :: p.edges`; `List.unattach_cons` is already used in Isomorphism.lean.
findings.fix: Replace with `rw [supportAttach_cons, List.unattach_cons, ih]` / `rw [edgesAttach_cons, List.unattach_cons, ih]` (or `simp [ih]`), and drop the `change`.
findings.issue: `supportAttach_unattach` and `edgesAttach_unattach` reach the cons case through `change _ :: ... = _ :: ...`, which depends on definitional unfolding of `unattach` and gives no comment saying why.

findings.evidence: Init/Data/List/Lemmas.lean:1224 `@[simp] theorem map_tail {f : α → β} {l : List α} :`.
findings.issue: `isCycle_mapPath` proves a local `htail : (l.map f).tail = l.tail.map f` by `cases l <;> rfl`, which duplicates the core lemma `List.map_tail`.

findings.evidence: The identical `have hc := mapWalk_cons f (x := ...)` block appears in each of the five aux proofs in the diff.
findings.fix: Factor out one lemma `mapWalk_cons'` stated over raw endpoints `{x y z : α}` with membership hypotheses (or a custom induction principle for walks between actual vertices), and use it in all five inductions.
findings.issue: Five private `_aux` lemmas (`mapWalk_reverse_aux`, `support_mapWalk_aux`, `vertexEquiv_mem_support_mapWalk_iff_aux`, `edges_mapWalk_aux`, `edgeEquiv_mem_edges_mapWalk_iff_aux`) each rebuild `have hc := mapWalk_cons f (x := (⟨x, hx⟩ : G.vertexSet)) (y := ⟨y, h.right_mem⟩) (z := ⟨z, hy⟩) e h p` by hand. Copying the same specialization five times hides a reusable fact.

findings.evidence: Diff: `rw [Walk.isTrail_def, edges_mapWalk, List.unattach, List.map_map, ..., ← Walk.edgesAttach_unattach, List.unattach, ...]`.
findings.fix: Prove it with `List.Nodup.map_on`/`List.nodup_map_iff` applied to `edges_mapWalk`, or with `simp [Walk.isTrail_def, edges_mapWalk, ← Walk.edgesAttach_unattach, List.nodup_map_iff, ...]`. Alternatively, state `edges_mapWalk` as a plain `List.map` of `fun e ↦ (f.edgeEquiv e : β')` so no unfolding is needed.
findings.issue: `isTrail_mapWalk` unfolds the definition `List.unattach` twice with `rw` and also reverse-rewrites `← Walk.edgesAttach_unattach`. This long chain of named-lemma rewrites breaks if `unattach` is redefined or renamed.

findings.evidence: Diff: `have q := f.symm.mapWalk p` / `simpa using (Nonempty.intro q)`; `Walk.copy` and `symm_vertexEquiv_apply_vertexEquiv` are both added in this PR.
findings.fix: Write `exact ⟨(f.symm.mapWalk p).copy (congrArg Subtype.val (symm_vertexEquiv_apply_vertexEquiv f x)) (congrArg Subtype.val (symm_vertexEquiv_apply_vertexEquiv f y))⟩`, using the `Walk.copy` this PR introduces for exactly this purpose.
findings.issue: In `reachable_iff`, `have q := f.symm.mapWalk p; simpa using (Nonempty.intro q)` depends on `simp` rewriting `f.symm.vertexEquiv (f.vertexEquiv x)` inside the endpoint indices of `Nonempty (G.Walk _ _)`. This index rewriting is fragile, and `have` discards the walk's data.

summary: Proofs rely on undocumented `change`, a re-derived core lemma, a hand-copied `mapWalk_cons` specialization repeated in five aux lemmas, and a `simpa` that rewrites inside the endpoint indices of a walk's type. All are fixable by small local refactors.
